member.summary: Reads and normalizes the settings file; null when it holds no settings object. Throws on a read or parse error. Call with the file mutex held.

member.name: M:Skua.Core.Services.UnifiedSettingsService.TryReloadSettings
member.summary: Re-reads the settings file so changes other VibeSkua processes saved are seen. On a read or parse error the settings in memory are kept and false is returned: falling back to defaults here would let the next save write those defaults over the user's file. A missing file counts as success (memory is all there is).

member.name: M:Skua.Core.Services.UnifiedSettingsService.TryUpdate``1(System.String,``0,System.Func{``0,``0},``0@)
member.summary: Reloads, changes and saves one setting as a single step under the cross-process file mutex, so a value several processes edit (a shared list) never loses another process's change made in between. Returns false, and writes nothing, when the reload fails; false too when the save fails (memory then keeps the old value). must return a new value rather than modify the one it is given.
